page.notes: The catchword "set" is read as the long-s form of "set" (completing "es-" as "esset"). Long s was normalised throughout (f read as s in confensu, consistat, sunt, similes, sortis, sibi, singuli, distant, es-). "fuere" was kept with f as a genuine Latin word, and the reading of its initial letter is uncertain. "asseuerandum" and "non ?" are copied as printed. The small mark at the left of the bottom line is not printed text and is left out.
